This template is to be used for citing individual pages on [[Wikipedia:Simon & Schuster|Simon & Schuster's]] [https://www.simonandschuster.com/ official website].

==Usage==
Copy the template code below and paste it into the appropriate place in an article, fill the required fields, and remove any that you don't use.

<code><nowiki>{{Simon&Schuster|subdomain=|domain=|url=|text=|archiveurl=|archivedate=|nobackup=}}</nowiki></code>

All fields need to be explicitly assigned to; otherwise, use of the "=" symbol in the URLs messes up the template.

===Required parameters===
*'''url''': URL of the web page, minus the domain name (<code><nowiki>https://www.simonandschuster.com/</nowiki></code>).
*'''text''': Name of the page being cited.
*For '''archive''' options, see [[#Backup links|Backup links]] below.

===Optional parameters===
*{{Para|subdomain}} The subdomain part of the web page's URL, for example, <code>catalog</code>. (Defaults to <code>www</code> if not specified).
*{{Para|domain}} The domain part of the web page's URL, for example, <code>co.uk</code>. (Defaults to <code>com</code> if not specified).
*{{Para|nolive}} When the original online content is no longer available, add "<code>|nolive=1</code>".

===Backup links===
{{BackupLinkHelp}}

==Example(s)==
<code><nowiki>{{Simon&Schuster|url=authors/Daniel-M-Lavery/146821625|text=Daniel M. Lavery|archivedate=20210330025109}}</nowiki></code>

Results in:

{{Simon&Schuster|url=authors/Daniel-M-Lavery/146821625|text=Daniel M. Lavery|archivedate=20210330025109}}
